definition: a decrease in the quality, quantity or importance of something (decline in + something)
exampleSentence: There has been a decline in the size of families.
exampleTranslation: Quy mô gia đình đã giảm đi.

definition: the process of becoming less, or the amount by which something becomes less (decrease in + something)
exampleSentence: There has been a significant decrease in the number of deaths from lung cancer.
exampleTranslation: Số ca tử vong do ung thư phổi đã giảm đáng kể.

definition: a time when someone or something has to wait, or the length of the wait (delay in + -ing)
exampleSentence: Why was there a delay in warning the public?
exampleTranslation: Tại sao lại có sự chậm trễ trong việc cảnh báo công chúng?

definition: the need or wish that people have for particular goods or services (demand for + something)
exampleSentence: There is a growing demand for new housing.
exampleTranslation: Nhu cầu về nhà ở mới ngày càng tăng.

definition: a piece of writing or speech that gives details about what someone or something is like (description of + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: The booklet gives a brief description of each place.
exampleTranslation: Cuốn sách nhỏ có mô tả ngắn gọn về từng địa điểm.

definition: a strong hope or wish for something (desire for + something)
exampleSentence: He had a great desire for knowledge.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy có khát khao tri thức rất lớn.

definition: a way in which two or more things are not like each other (difference between + two things)
exampleSentence: Do children know the difference between right and wrong?
exampleTranslation: Trẻ em có biết sự khác biệt giữa đúng và sai không?

definition: a way in which two or more things are not alike in some respect (difference in + something)
exampleSentence: Researchers found important differences in the way boys and girls learn.
exampleTranslation: Các nhà nghiên cứu tìm thấy những khác biệt quan trọng trong cách trẻ trai và trẻ gái học.

definition: a problem you have when doing something; the in is optional (difficulty in + -ing)
exampleSentence: They had great difficulty in finding a replacement.
exampleTranslation: Họ gặp rất nhiều khó khăn khi tìm người thay thế.

definition: a problem or something that causes trouble (difficulty with + something)
exampleSentence: There are several difficulties with this theory.
exampleTranslation: Lý thuyết này có nhiều điểm khó khăn.

definition: the way something moves, faces or is aimed (direction of + something)
exampleSentence: The suspects were last seen heading in the direction of Miami.
exampleTranslation: Nghi phạm được thấy lần cuối đang đi về hướng Miami.

definition: a reduction in the usual price of something (discount on + something)
exampleSentence: The Young Persons Railcard gives you a discount on rail travel.
exampleTranslation: Thẻ tàu dành cho người trẻ giúp bạn được giảm giá khi đi tàu.

definition: talk in which people exchange ideas about something (discussion about + something)
exampleSentence: We have had discussions about her legal situation.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đã thảo luận về tình hình pháp lý của cô ấy.

definition: talk in which people exchange ideas about something (discussion of + something)
exampleSentence: The book includes a discussion of important issues.
exampleTranslation: Cuốn sách có phần thảo luận về những vấn đề quan trọng.

definition: something that causes problems or makes someone or something less successful (disadvantage of + something)
exampleSentence: The disadvantage of the material is that it fades in strong sunlight.
exampleTranslation: Nhược điểm của loại vải này là nó bị phai màu dưới nắng gắt.

definition: a feeling of being not sure whether something is true or right (doubt about + something)
exampleSentence: The incident raises doubts about the safety of nuclear power.
exampleTranslation: Sự cố này làm dấy lên nghi ngờ về độ an toàn của điện hạt nhân.

definition: a reduction in the amount, level or number of something (drop in + something)
exampleSentence: Manufacturers report a big drop in new orders.
exampleTranslation: Các nhà sản xuất cho biết đơn hàng mới giảm mạnh.

definition: a change caused by an event or action (effect of + something)
exampleSentence: I could feel the effects of the thin mountain air.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cảm nhận được tác động của không khí loãng trên núi.

definition: a change caused in someone or something by an event (effect on + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: My parents' divorce had a big effect on me.
exampleTranslation: Việc bố mẹ ly hôn ảnh hưởng lớn đến tôi.

definition: special attention or importance given to something (emphasis on + something)
exampleSentence: In Japan there is a lot of emphasis on politeness.
exampleTranslation: Ở Nhật Bản, người ta rất nhấn mạnh vào sự lịch sự.

definition: the last part of a period of time, event or story (end of + something)
exampleSentence: Costs are expected to double by the end of 2030.
exampleTranslation: Chi phí dự kiến sẽ tăng gấp đôi vào cuối năm 2030.

definition: a door or gate you go through to enter a place (entrance to + place)
exampleSentence: Meet me at the main entrance to the school.
exampleTranslation: Gặp tôi ở lối vào chính của trường nhé.

definition: facts or signs that show something exists or is true (evidence of + something)
exampleSentence: At present we have no evidence of life on other planets.
exampleTranslation: Hiện nay chúng ta chưa có bằng chứng về sự sống trên hành tinh khác.

definition: facts or signs that support a claim (evidence for + something)
exampleSentence: There is no evidence for these claims.
exampleTranslation: Không có bằng chứng nào cho những tuyên bố này.

definition: a specific fact or thing used to explain or support a general idea (example of + something)
exampleSentence: Can anyone give me an example of a transitive verb?
exampleTranslation: Ai có thể cho tôi một ví dụ về ngoại động từ không?

definition: a reason you give to explain careless or bad behaviour (excuse for + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: What's your excuse for being late this time?
exampleTranslation: Lần này bạn có lý do gì cho việc đến muộn?

definition: something or someone not included in a general statement or rule (exception to + the rule)
exampleSentence: Most of the boys were shy, but Larry was the exception to the rule.
exampleTranslation: Hầu hết các cậu bé đều nhút nhát, nhưng Larry là ngoại lệ.

definition: knowledge or skill you gain from doing a job or activity (experience in + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: I had some experience in fashion design.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đã có chút kinh nghiệm trong thiết kế thời trang.

definition: knowledge or skill you gain from doing something, or something that happened to you (experience of + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: You've got a lot of experience of lecturing.
exampleTranslation: Bạn có nhiều kinh nghiệm giảng dạy.

definition: the reasons you give for why something happened (explanation for + something)
exampleSentence: Can you think of any explanation for this failure?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có nghĩ ra lời giải thích nào cho thất bại này không?

definition: a statement that describes how something works or why it is so (explanation of + something)
exampleSentence: I'll give you a quick explanation of how the machine works.
exampleTranslation: Tôi sẽ giải thích nhanh cho bạn cách máy này hoạt động.

definition: a strong feeling of trust or confidence in someone or something (faith in + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: I still have faith in him.
exampleTranslation: Tôi vẫn còn niềm tin vào anh ấy.

definition: a reduction in the amount, level or price of something (fall in + something)
exampleSentence: There has been a fall in oil prices.
exampleTranslation: Giá dầu đã giảm.

definition: the feeling you get when you are afraid that something bad may happen (fear of + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: She has a fear of flying.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy sợ đi máy bay.

definition: an emotion that you feel, such as anger, sadness or happiness (feeling of + emotion)
exampleSentence: He had a terrible feeling of guilt.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy có cảm giác tội lỗi khủng khiếp.

definition: the process of trying to achieve something or stop something bad (fight for + something)
exampleSentence: They joined the fight for justice and democracy.
exampleTranslation: Họ tham gia cuộc đấu tranh cho công lý và dân chủ.

definition: a natural ability (gift for + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: She has a gift for languages.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy có năng khiếu ngoại ngữ.

definition: a book or text that gives information about a particular subject (guide to + subject)
translation: cẩm nang về, hướng dẫn về
exampleSentence: I bought a guide to North American birds.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mua một cuốn cẩm nang về các loài chim Bắc Mỹ.

definition: an angry feeling of extreme dislike for someone or something (hatred of + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: He showed an intense hatred of all foreigners.
exampleTranslation: Ông ta bộc lộ sự căm ghét tột độ với mọi người nước ngoài.

definition: things you do to make it easier for someone to do something (help with + something)
exampleSentence: Do you want any help with the washing up?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có cần giúp rửa chén không?

definition: a chance of succeeding or of something good happening (hope of + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: It was rush hour, and there was no hope of getting a seat.
exampleTranslation: Lúc đó là giờ cao điểm nên không còn hy vọng kiếm được chỗ ngồi.

definition: an image in your mind of what something is like or should be (idea of + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: I only have a vague idea of the kind of work I'll be doing.
exampleTranslation: Tôi chỉ có ý niệm mơ hồ về loại công việc mình sẽ làm.

definition: a plan or suggestion for a possible course of action (idea for + something)
exampleSentence: The idea for the book came from an old war movie.
exampleTranslation: Ý tưởng cho cuốn sách đến từ một bộ phim chiến tranh cũ.

definition: the effect or influence of an event or situation (impact of + something)
exampleSentence: They discussed the impact of global warming.
exampleTranslation: Họ thảo luận về tác động của hiện tượng nóng lên toàn cầu.

definition: the effect or influence that something has on someone or something (impact on + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: Higher mortgage rates have already had a major impact on spending.
exampleTranslation: Lãi suất thế chấp cao hơn đã tác động mạnh đến chi tiêu.

definition: the act of improving something, or the state of being better (improvement in + something)
exampleSentence: There has been a big improvement in the children's behaviour.
exampleTranslation: Hành vi của bọn trẻ đã cải thiện nhiều.

definition: a rise in amount, number or degree (increase in + something)
exampleSentence: There has been an increase in the crime rate.
exampleTranslation: Tỷ lệ tội phạm đã tăng.

definition: the power to affect how someone or something develops or behaves (influence on + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: His works have had an influence on many modern writers.
exampleTranslation: Các tác phẩm của ông đã ảnh hưởng đến nhiều nhà văn hiện đại.

definition: the power to affect how someone or something develops or behaves (influence over + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: The unions have a lot of influence over local politics.
exampleTranslation: Các công đoàn có nhiều ảnh hưởng đối với chính trị địa phương.

definition: facts or details that tell you something about a situation or person (information about + something)
exampleSentence: The book contains information about a wide variety of subjects.
exampleTranslation: Cuốn sách có thông tin về rất nhiều chủ đề.
